title: the ground_loop second-loop proof roots its imports at its own checkout
intention: test_a_second_loop_exits_quietly_and_force_replaces_it.py computes REPO as parents[6], the checkout, so its `import cairn` measures this tree's ground_loop and not the main checkout's editable install.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 on origin/main 2889bdd1f: proof_coverage.misrooted_proofs names exactly this proof at line 22 (`sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))` with REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5], which resolves to <checkout>/cairn, not the checkout; parents[6] is the checkout). So test_a_proof_roots_its_imports_at_its_own_checkout reds over the real tree, and run outside the tester this proof measures main's code, so a hollow cannot red it. The file's path is cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/proofs/, which is one level deeper than the parents[5] its author counted.
traces_to: Law 3 (a proof measures this tree), Law 8 (a hollow a proof cannot see is a hollow green).
how: Change parents[5] to parents[6] on the REPO line; add one tooth that calls proof_coverage.misrooted_inserts on __file__ and asserts [] (red on the unfixed line, green fixed). Red-first.

clauses.claim: misrooted_inserts over this proof returns [] (its sys.path entry is the checkout root), and over the real tree test_a_proof_roots_its_imports_at_its_own_checkout reads green

decisions.text: D1: REPO = parents[6]; the one new tooth reads the tool's published scan.

measured.saw: misrooted_proofs('.') on origin/main names this proof only: [{'line': 22, 'resolves_to': 'cairn', 'source': 'sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO))'}]; Path(__file__).resolve().parents[5] is <checkout>/cairn and parents[6] is <checkout>
measured.how: python3 over a worktree of origin/main 2889bdd1f on akiendell
